rule_description: Successful withdrawal decreases account balance and returns success
condition: Valid active account, amount positive, sufficient funds, successful file operations
action: New balance = old balance - amount; response status 0, alert 0, balance and stamp

rule_description: Journal debit entry on successful withdrawal
condition: Account rewrite succeeded; journal write attempted
action: Initialize journal; stamp and TX02 code; debit account=request account; amount=request amount; credit account remains initialized; write journal

condition: Candidate stamp from date+time+terminal+4-digit sequence; journal READ collision
action: Increment sequence until unused stamp; at 9999 collision raise 1006 Journal stamp exhausted

rule_description: Attempt account rollback on journal write failure
condition: Journal write fails after successful account rewrite
action: 9002 Journal write error; read account; if read succeeds, restore old balance and rewrite; rollback outcome is not separately reported
9002 Journal file error; close open files; return

condition: Account READ status other than 00 or 23
Journal lookup READ status other than 00 or 23
action: 9002 Journal file error; exit stamp search before account rewrite

condition: JOURNAL-RECORD WRITE status not 00 after account rewrite
action: 9002 Journal write error; attempt account rollback
